paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 5.89, representing a 4.77% decrease from the prior close and a 10.7% decrease over the last 22 sessions.

The recent news headlines are focused on the company's leadership changes, financial performance, and project updates. A filing with the SEC stated that CEO Toby Neugebauer had left the company as of April 17, 2026, and an Interim Office of the CEO had been set up. The company also reported expectations to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. Additionally, there was one Form 4 filing, but no Form 144 filings.
